h1: The 7 Best 18-Inch Lawn Mowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: seven 18-inch lawn mowers across gas, cordless and manual reel, compared on engine, drive, deck and the yard each suits.
summary: The Wild Badger Power 40V 18-Inch is our best overall because it is a quiet, low-maintenance brushless cordless mower. The PowerSmart EasyCut 4-cycle is the best gas pick for small to mid-size yards, and the steel-deck PowerSmart handles rougher ground. The Great States 815-18 is the zero-maintenance reel for flat lawns.
intro: An 18-inch deck is the sweet spot for small and mid-size yards, wide enough to avoid endless passes and narrow enough to slip through a side gate. But 18 inches comes in three completely different machines: gas, cordless and manual reel. The right one depends far more on your upkeep tolerance than on the deck.

We reviewed seven 18-inch mowers on paper, ranking them on power source, deck material, height adjustment and the yard type each suits. We relied on the spec lines and owner feedback, with no lab-style claims.

products.name: Wild Badger Power 40V 18-Inch Brushless Cordless Electric Lawn Mower
products.verdict: A quiet brushless cordless mower with no gas to handle.
products.description:
The Wild Badger has an 18-inch deck, a 40V brushless motor and a cordless battery platform.

It ranks first because it removes gas, oil and pull cords from the job while keeping the 18-inch width. Against the gas PowerSmart models below, you give up long runtime flexibility but gain quiet, low-maintenance operation. The listing falls in the $100-200 bracket.

Buy it for a small yard where quiet matters. The caveat is that runtime depends on the battery you get.
products.idealFor: Small yards where quiet, low-maintenance mowing matters.
products.skipIf: You want unlimited runtime from a gas tank.

products.name: PowerSmart EasyCut 18-Inch Gas Lawn Mower, 144cc 4-Cycle Engine
products.verdict: A light 144cc 4-cycle gas mower with 5 height positions.
products.description:
The PowerSmart EasyCut has an 18-inch deck, a 144cc 4-cycle gas engine, side discharge and five-position height adjustment.

It ranks second because it is the best of the gas mowers here for ordinary yards. It undercuts the cordless Wild Badger on runtime flexibility, with no battery to run flat. The listing falls in the $100-200 bracket.

Choose it for a modest yard that suits a light gas mower. The caveat is gas and oil upkeep.

products.name: PowerSmart EasyCut 18-Inch Gas Lawn Mower, 144cc OHV Engine, Steel Deck
products.verdict: A steel-deck gas mower for roots, curbs and rougher terrain.
products.description:
This PowerSmart has an 18-inch steel deck, a 144cc OHV engine and five-position dual-lever height adjustment.

It ranks third because the steel deck is its edge over the otherwise similar 4-cycle model, standing up better to roots and curbs. It sits in the same $100-200 bracket.

Choose it for yards with roots, curbs or uneven ground. The caveat is that a steel deck can add weight.
products.idealFor: Yards with roots, curbs or rough terrain.
products.skipIf: Your lawn is flat and smooth.

products.name: 18-Inch 40V Max Brushless Cordless Self-Propelled Lawn Mower
products.verdict: The only 18 inch cordless here with self-propelled drive.
products.description:
This 40V Max mower has an 18-inch deck, a brushless motor and self-propelled drive on a cordless platform.

It ranks fourth because it is from a newer, unproven seller, even though self-propel is a real advantage on slopes. It sits in the $100-200 bracket, like the Wild Badger.

Choose it if you want drive assistance on a cordless 18-inch deck. The caveat is the thinner track record.
products.idealFor: Cordless buyers who want drive assistance.

products.name: Great States 815-18 18-Inch 5-Blade Push Reel Lawn Mower
products.verdict: A quiet five-blade reel with no gas, battery or cord.
products.description:
The Great States 815-18 is an 18-inch push reel mower with five blades and no gas, battery or cord.

It ranks fifth because manual power suits only certain lawns. It costs more than the LawnMaster reel below. The listing falls in the $100-200 bracket.

Choose it for a flat, tidy lawn of small size. The caveat is that tall grass is hard to push through.
products.skipIf: You let the grass grow long.

products.name: LawnMaster LMRM1801 Push Reel Lawn Mower 18-Inch 5-Blade
products.verdict: A five-blade manual reel for less than $100.
products.description:
The LawnMaster LMRM1801 is an 18-inch push reel with five blades and no gas, battery or cord.

It ranks sixth because it matches the Great States on design but costs less, in the $50-100 bracket, which makes it the entry point. The ranking gap is small.

Choose it on a budget for a small, regularly maintained lawn. The caveat is that, like any reel, it needs frequent mowing.
products.idealFor: Budget buyers with small, tidy lawns.
products.skipIf: Your grass gets long between cuts.

products.name: PowerSmart 18-Inch 144cc Gas Lawn Mower, Push Mower with Side-Discharge
products.verdict: A no-frills 144cc gas push mower with side discharge.
products.description:
This PowerSmart is an 18-inch push mower with a 144cc gas engine and side discharge.

It ranks last because it lists fewer details than the EasyCut models, such as height positions or deck material. Expect it in the $100 to $200 bracket.

Choose it for a simple gas push mower without a bagging kit. The caveat is that it has no bagging option.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a basic gas push mower.

whatMatters.detail: Gas gives long runtime but needs fuel and oil. Cordless is quiet but limited by the battery. A reel needs no power but your effort. Check the title for gas, cordless or reel.
A steel deck resists dents from roots and curbs better than lighter plastic. It adds weight. Look for the material in the listing bullets.
More positions let you tune cut height for the season. Five positions is common. Check the stated number.
A 144cc 4-cycle or OHV engine runs on straight gas with separate oil. It is simpler than a 2-stroke. Check the engine line on the listing.
Side discharge throws clippings out the side, and bagging catches them. Some models have no bag option. Check what the listing says.

faq.a: It suits small to mid-size yards. Larger lawns need more passes, so consider a wider deck.
They pick by deck width and ignore power source. Gas, cordless and reel need very different upkeep.

faq.q: Is cordless worth it over gas?
faq.a: For small yards, yes. For long sessions, a gas PowerSmart has no battery to run flat.

faq.q: How do I start a gas mower?
faq.a: Add fuel and oil per the manual and pull the cord. Follow all safety steps.

faq.q: How do I maintain a reel mower?
faq.a: Keep the blades clean and adjusted. Consult the manual for blade contact guidance.

faq.q: Can I use a reel on rough ground?
faq.a: It is a poor fit. The steel-deck PowerSmart handles roots and curbs better.

finalTake: The Wild Badger Power 40V 18-Inch is the best all-round 18-inch mower for small yards. The PowerSmart EasyCut 4-Cycle is the gas pick, and the steel-deck model handles rough ground. Choose a reel only if your lawn is flat and you mow often.
